evidence.observation: O2 baseline ~4-6 ppm during ramp/early growth rises to 14.8 then 19.4 ppm at constant T and Ar
Temperature at setpoint 750 °C, Ar 99.6 sccm, pressure ~761 Torr all nominal

args.missing_evidence: Further O2 trend (continued rise vs. return to baseline) and a leak-check/Ar-flow perturbation test to distinguish a seal leak from an O2 sensor artifact
